# openwrt_sys_net_devices (Data Source)

Retrieves information about network devices from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (List of Object) List of network devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Internal ID.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `flags` (String)
- `ip6addr` (String)
- `ipaddr` (String)
- `macaddr` (String)
- `mtu` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `rx_bytes` (Number)
- `rx_packets` (Number)
- `tx_bytes` (Number)
- `tx_packets` (Number)
